answer: Seat weight comes from a max-flow cut on the vouch graph, not headcount: each key issues at most 3 vouches and any cluster can route at most 12% of ferrous-weighted stake behind one graph cut. A botnet vouching only internally collapses to a thin island whose min-cut gives near-zero voting power, so 500 clones earn the same capped seat as one honest agent drawing vouches from a wide orchard of unrelated operators. Fresh keys sit 30 days in probation, so attack cost is locked non-transferable stake per identity while honest agents pay once.
